preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(N) <= 18 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case N has between 1 and 18 digits.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output[i]) <= factorial(len(test_cases[i])) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output rank is a positive integer within the factorial of the number of digits in the corresponding test case.
